column1: For jewelcrafting I chose to make things closer to the trivial.  That gives a better chance to make the item, thus selling it back to recoup the costs.
Ruby is the highest gem available on merchants.  It is recommended to save all black sapphires, jacinth, diamonds, and blue diamonds for 280+
All trivials and combines assume enchanted bars.  Non-enchanted bar trivials are lower.  Champagne Magnum requires an enchanted bar.
